{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MC-009","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"title","page":1,"quote":"SHAFT"}],"comment":"The drawing is titled 'SHAFT' and shows multiple turned diameters (D15, D14/D16) but does not specify centre holes at the shaft ends. Without centre holes the machinist cannot support the part between centres for turning or grinding, which matters especially given the tight tolerances and the post-plating grinding called out in note N3. The designer should add centre hole callouts (e.g., per ISO 6411) at both ends of the shaft."

,"recommended_correction":"Add centre hole specifications to both ends of the shaft."}]}
